item.title: PMH Flooding, Power Outages, Causeway Danger
item.ns0:title: PMH Flooding, Power Outages, Causeway Danger
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, heavy rainfall exposes critical vulnerabilities at Princess Margaret Hospital as the opposition slams the official response to widespread flooding in the emergency department. We head to Grand Bahama where a former parliamentarian warns of a dangerous situation involving a deteriorating causeway, while a woman is in custody following a fatal hit-and-run in the capital. A former Works Minister breaks his silence on the root causes behind persistent BPL blackouts as investigators share a major update on the recovery of wreckage from the North Andros plane crash. Plus, we take you inside a massive joint drug interdiction and join the community of Fox Hill as they gear up for historic Emancipation Day celebrations.
-----
